allocations.rationale: DEMO synthetic — no real whale data available (placeholders only)

limitations: Realised PnL only (no unrealised). A whale with large open winning trades is undervalued.
Equal-weight across top-N coins is a heuristic, not risk-adjusted.
method: realised PnL ranking over window -> rank-decay filter (threshold 2 places) -> top-N coins by aggregate signed notional from survivors -> equal weight
